responsibility: Implements the Bulldozer-family dispatch-scheduling helper logic used by the x86 backend for bdver1 through bdver4. It models dispatch windows in terms of instruction bytes, uops, immediates, loads, stores, branches, and compare/jcc grouping, tracks scheduled instructions against those windows, detects dispatch-rule violations, and exposes query and update entry points that let the scheduler reason about whether a ready instruction fits the current Bulldozer dispatch constraints.
